`compile` is GNU Automake's compiler wrapper from commit
`18416d641dc5c220ec82283ff43cdaa7cb0d619c` (v1.16.5),
[upstream file](https://github.com/autotools-mirror/automake/blob/18416d641dc5c220ec82283ff43cdaa7cb0d619c/lib/compile).

SHA-256: `c207b390aac6323062b982214a6c63448e53e6911107993abe96f35fe7a30a18`.

The file retains its copyright, GNU GPL terms and special distribution exception.
It supplies the missing PSBLAS-EXT Autoconf auxiliary script. The PSBLAS source
gitlink contains an empty `compile` placeholder, so that file is not used as a
compiler wrapper.
